note: TEXT LOCK (preview_video/src/render/videoplate.js): inside these regions the plate shader always shows the still painting, so a take's garbled text never shows. rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1]; poly = [[x, y], ...]. pad grows each region (px), feather softens its edge (px).
